designSummary: Overview of reviews; effects summarised per intervention level with AMSTAR 2 ratings and certainty judgements; no new meta-analysis unless overlap is low.
sampleSize: No sample size in the trial sense: the unit is the review and the number is fixed by the search. The four leads suggest at least four eligible reviews; a plausible yield is 15 to 30. Workload sets the scope: about 1,500 titles at one minute each (25 hours), about 120 full texts at 15 minutes (30 hours), extraction of up to 25 reviews at 90 minutes (38 hours) and AMSTAR 2 at 30 minutes each (13 hours), about 106 hours against 120 available. If the yield exceeds 30 reviews, the scope narrows to reviews published from 2015.
primaryAnalysis: For each intervention level, tabulate the reported change in appropriate anticoagulation with its interval, the AMSTAR 2 rating and the number of primary studies; judge certainty per comparison with GRADE as applied to overviews. Where overlap (corrected covered area) exceeds 15 percent for a comparison, report only the most recent high-quality review for that comparison.
secondaryAnalysis: Same tabulation for stroke, major bleeding and decisional conflict where reported; PROGRESS-Plus descriptors of included populations; a sensitivity summary excluding reviews rated critically low.
missingData: Outcomes a review did not report are marked not reported, never assumed null; missing review characteristics are requested from authors once.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests; comparisons are descriptive with certainty ratings.
software: Covidence-style screening in a shared spreadsheet; R for the citation matrix and corrected covered area.
overfittingGuards: Inclusion criteria and outcome list fixed in the registered protocol
No post hoc regrouping of intervention levels
Overlap threshold fixed at 15 percent before extraction
summary: Unit of analysis is the review; workload of about 106 hours fits the 120 available; certainty rated per comparison.
